content.comment_body: Hello, I do not have this device yet and have no experience with PLCs. My goal is to use the [product_name] simply as a digital I/O device. Is it possible to write to outputs with Modbus Function Code 15 (Write Multiple Coils) and read from digital inputs using Function Code 2 (Read Discrete Inputs)? If so, which addresses should be used? Does any code need to be running on the [product_name] if I am only reading and writing to the I/O without adding any logic?

Apologies, but I'm not fully sure what you're aiming to accomplish. What is the purpose of only reading inputs and outputs without applying any logic? The [product_name] supports a limited set of Modbus functions and is programmed using a graphical interface ([product_name] Soft Comfort). Programming is typically done with ladder diagrams or function block diagrams. It may help if you describe your requirements more specifically.

Thank you for your response. The idea is to use the device merely for monitoring basic digital inputs and outputs via Modbus, essentially as a replacement for another similar unit (since that unit currently has a six-month lead time, and we need something quickly for a project). [url] As mentioned, no logic is needed; we simply want to read inputs and write outputs (coils).

Which specific [product_name] model do you have? Please provide the full order number ([article_no]). Is your [product_name] configured as a client or server? If it supports Modbus, it will only work with Modbus TCP/IP, not RTU or ASCII.
